summary.headline: Modena Codex Astrological Excerpts
summary.text: Catalog of excerpts and notes in a Modena astrological codex, covering triangles, universal climes, zodiacal regions, planetary qualities, eclipse and comet colors, zodiacal signs, bodily form and temperament, planetary houses and exaltations, planetary activity, injuries, lunar applications, luminary syzygies, and the 57 zones of the heavenly sphere. Most entries are identified with books and chapters of the Tetrabiblos, with additional Byzantine and astronomical notes.
